endpoints.remaining: Live failed-generation and network-recovery branches were not deliberately induced; fixture tests remain distinct.

endpoints.remaining: Expired-link renewal and hostile URI scenarios have local tests; no additional live renewal by this auditor. Production storage/deployment remains separate.
